phase22d_reset_handler_note.decision: IDENTISCH is correct for reset_handler body
rationale: C source for reset_handler is identical in version_a.c and version_b.c.
Machine bytes at file offsets 0x68 (A) and 0x74 (B) for the 12-byte body are identical: 072000bf014a904702e000bf.
Only the following literal-pool pointer differs (relocated process_input address); code-address immediates are excluded from fingerprints by design.
process_input itself is structurally changed; that is a callee dependency change, not a body change of reset_handler.
Therefore listing reset_handler under structurally_changed was incorrect Ground Truth from Phase 2.2C.
phase22d_reset_handler_note.optionalNote: calleeChanged=process_input (transitive dependency; not a body diff)
